subject: Post-demo follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (PulseHealth)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Morales <sara@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@pulsehealth.com
Date: 2027-09-07T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: IAM evidence & SOC 2 questions (PulseHealth)

Hi Sara — thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the security intake side.

Recap (short):
- PulseHealth is evaluating Redwood for inference in clinical workflows (low-latency, auditable requests).
- Key compliance asks: SOC 2 status, HIPAA data handling controls, and identity/access evidence for SSO and admin controls.

Immediate asks from our side: (can you confirm the items below or point me to the right person?)
1) SOC 2: current status (Type I/II), date of last audit, and whether a SOC 2 report can be shared under an NDA.
2) SSO: provider (Okta/OneLogin/etc.), whether SAML metadata is available, and if you support SCIM provisioning today.
3) RBAC/admin controls: a short exported list of admin users and how roles map to admin capabilities.
4) Expected timeline: when we can expect the artifacts (SOC 2 or attestation + SAML metadata + admin list).

I've attached a one-page checklist to show the fields we typically need (redwood_iam_checklist_v1.xlsx) — if it's easier, share whatever you have and we can map it on our side.

Next steps I propose:
- You to share SOC 2 status + SAML metadata or a point of contact in security within 2 business days.
- Internal touchpoint: bring in our security engineer (cc'd on follow-ups) if there are technical questions.

Thanks — happy to jump on a brief call with your security team if that helps.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. Appreciate the checklist, that helps. Short answers below and next actions on our side.

1) SOC 2: We are currently undergoing a Type II audit (in flight). We can share a redacted interim report under NDA; full Type II expected Q4. I'll confirm the timeline with our GRC lead.
2) SSO: We use Okta with SAML 2.0 (metadata available). SCIM provisioning is not yet enabled across all apps — it's on our roadmap for the quarter after next.
3) RBAC/admins: I can pull a CSV of admin accounts and role names — will include owner emails and primary role descriptions.
4) Timeline: aiming to get SAML metadata + admins export to you within 48 business hours; SOC 2 documents will need an NDA (please send).

From security@pulsehealth.com: happy to connect; prefer to exchange SAML metadata via secure link or SFTP.

I will send the initial artifacts shortly (SAML metadata + admins list). Procurement is cc'd to track the commercial docs.

Thanks,
Sara Morales
Head of Product Operations | PulseHealth
sara@pulsehealth.com

Hi Sara — quick technical note from our security team (looping Rishi for visibility). Thanks for confirming Okta/SAML. A couple of specifics that will make the intake much faster: 

- SAML metadata: preferred as an XML file (IdP metadata) with entityID and ACS URLs. If you have an Okta application export, that works.
- SCIM: if not enabled, can you share whether you support a SCIM beta endpoint or if provisioning is strictly manual today? We ask because it affects our onboarding automation.
- Admins export: CSV with columns: email, full_name, role_name, role_description, is_service_account (yes/no).
- RBAC: any mapping doc that indicates which roles have user management privileges (create/disable users, assign roles) helps us map required audit controls.

I'll attach a one-row template for the admins export and an evidence matrix we use to map artifacts to our review (id-access-evidence_matrix.csv). If easier, we can take a short screenshare to walk through the metadata.

Timing: if PulseHealth can provide the IdP metadata and admins list within 48 hours, our team can complete the initial mapping and surface any further gaps the same week.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: id-access-evidence_matrix.csv (CSV stub)
